objectives: At month 12: at most one unhoused household, and no more unhoused households or experienced commute minutes than the matched reserve branch; cumulative public capital expense at most 4,000 synthetic USD. All three conditions required per seed. No welfare or moral verdict.

challenges.rule: Pareto: no selected metric worse beyond its explicit tolerance, and at least one strictly better; all enabled guards and both budget caps must pass.
